scope: Motion/H67 multiplier-free eight-source FC2 signed-weight reduction and Acc24 update island

numeric_identity.rule: an active sn2 event contributes exactly one signed INT8 FC2 weight for the frozen checkpoint
numeric_identity.paft_requirement: PAFT threshold identity must be checked; any non-unit value requires exact folded weights or a multiplier path before composition

arithmetic_order: four signed9 pair sums, two signed10 quad sums, one signed11 eight-source sum, then one signed25 extended accumulator addition per output lane; truncate only after explicit signed24 overflow detection

m182_link.qualification: analytic schedule boundary only; M183 excludes bank queues, source selection, weight SRAM response, BN2 and residual commit

fail_closed_exclusions: event bitmap to eight distinct-bank source scheduling and queue lifetime
eight simultaneous 96-byte weight-row SRAM reads and response tags
complete token/context accumulator ownership and writeback
PAFT checkpoint and valid825 threshold/accuracy admission
FC2 final requantization, dynamic BN2 moment barrier and residual commit
macro-aware timing, power, energy, FPS, full FFN or system speedup
